work.title: Embracing Lovers
work.description: Spray-painted on a white exterior wall, continuous orange and black linework depicts two intertwined figures with red-accented facial features, hands, and red shorts, accompanied by smaller marginal characters including a snowman and a helmeted figure at lower left. Signed 'Ricky Bird' in the lower-right corner; a metal bollard and bicycle wheel partially occupy the foreground.
work.composition: central figure mural with snowman witnesses
